sentences.text:
Shri D.S. Kushwaha - Additional Advocate General for the 
1.

Heard on I.A. No.8486/2025, first application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant.
2 . This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 04th April, 2025 passed by Special Judge (POCSO) Act, Bhind (M.P.), whereby appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
 Section Imprisonment Fine Default  363 IPC 05 Years' RI 2,000/- 06 mon  366 IPC 05 Years' RI 2,000/- 06 mon  6 POCSO Act Life Imprisonment 5,000/- 06 mont  376(2)(n) and 376(3) of IPC 3.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the appellant that the trial Court erred in convicting and awarding jail sentence to present appellant.

Infact, it is a case of consensual relationship because prosecutrix in her statements recorded under Section 161, 164 as well as Court statement,
specifically submits that she shared emotional as well as physical proximity with the appellant on her own volition and they stayed together for some days that too without raising any alarm at the instance of prosecutrix.
Besides that, prosecutrix is at the cusp of attaining majority and the appeal being of the year 2025 is not likely to be concluded in near future and appellant has a good case on the merits.
Appellant undertakes to abide by the terms and conditions as imposed by this court.
Under such circumstances, learned counsel for the appellant prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
4. Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposed the application and prays for its rejection while supporting the impugned judgment.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and record perused.
6. Considering the submissions advanced and in the obtaining facts and circumstances, but without commenting on the merits of the case, I.A. No.8486/2025 is allowed.

It is ordered that on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, jail sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended till disposal of this appeal subject to deposit of the fine amount, if not already deposited, and he be released on bail.
Appellant is further directed to remain present before the Registry of this Court on 01/08/2025 and, thereafter, on such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this behalf.

7. Application stands allowed and disposed of.
8.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.

(ANAND PATHAK)
